spans.s: Obeisance,Ⓒs.ⒹnamaskAraH; praRAmaH, praRati f., vaMdanaM, praRipAtaH, namasyA; aBivAdanaM; ‘prostrate o(beisance)’ sAzwAMgapraRAmaH-namaskAraH, azwAMga-pAtaH; ‘to make an o(beisance)’ praRam 1 P, praRipat 1 P, namaskf 8 U, aBivad c.

Obey,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓ(Orders) kf 8 U, anu-zWA 1 P, anuvft 1 A, anuvi-DA 3 U, pA c. (pAlayati), anuruD 4 A, man c., pratigrah 9 P, aByupa-i 2 P or gam 1 P; (persons) vacanaM Sru 5 P, SAsane sTA, AjYAM-vacanaM-anuvft, yaTAdizwaM vi-DA; Sru desid. (SuSrU-zate), upacar 1 P, sev 1 A, upAs 2 A, AjYAM kf or anuruD &c.
ⓃObedient,Ⓒa.ⒹAjYAnuvartin, AjYAkara (rI f.), AjYAviDAyin, anuviDAyin, anu-roDin, AjYA-nideSa-kArin, AjYApara, viDeya, vinayagrAhin, vacane sTita, ASrava, vaSya, praReya, vaSAnuga, SuSrUzu, AjYAvacana-grAhin-sevin, AjYADIna; ‘o(bedient) to oneʼs parent’ pitfvaSya, pitfvacanapara.
Ⓝ[Obedient]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹAjYAnusAreRa, yaTAjYaM, yaTAdizwaM, nideSAnu-roDena.
ⓃObedience,Ⓒs.ⒹAjYAnuvartanaM-anu-roDaH-anusAraH-anusaraRaM-karaRaM-pAlanaM-sevanaM-DAraRaM, vaSyatA, anuviDAyityaM, SuSrUzA, AjYA-karatvaM, AjYAparatA, anuvartanaM, anuroDaH.
